evidence_focus: Files restore continuation focused backend-real gate
runtime flake versus stability blocker classification

files.pending: For Files browse/list/download/live read, observe the storage payload root and return typed pending/failed (file_library_list_pending/file_library_list_failed) when the payload root projection is unavailable; do not trigger runtime-access release or read a stale projection.
files.releasing: For restore/quiesced save or restore operations, continue release/quiesce convergence and return typed pending while non-terminal; Files browse/list/download/live read still observes the payload root without release-before-read.
files.offline: Files browse/list/download/live read observes the storage payload root directly; do not create a read export or synthesize runtime access.
files.not_found: Files browse/list/download/live read observes the storage payload root directly; return typed pending/failed when projection is unavailable and do not synthesize an executable connector.

agent_task_sandbox.pending: Continue bounded ASBCP status checks until Running, Failed, or timeout.
agent_task_sandbox.releasing: Wait for workload release or surface a typed release-incomplete error; do not start a second task HOME holder.
agent_task_sandbox.offline: Call ASBCP create-or-ensure for the workload, then continue status checks until Running, Failed, or timeout.
agent_task_sandbox.not_found: Call ASBCP create-or-ensure for the workload, then continue status checks until Running, Failed, or timeout.

afscp_workspace_binding.pending: Files browse/list/download/live read observes the storage payload root and does not wait on or start workspace-binding release; return typed pending/failed only if the payload root projection is unavailable. Explicit restore/quiesced operations continue through the workspace binding owner.
afscp_workspace_binding.releasing: Continue release convergence through the workspace binding owner until terminal released/revoked/expired/deleted for explicit restore/quiesced operations; Files browse/list/download/live read observes the payload root instead of waiting for terminal release.
afscp_workspace_binding.offline: Treat as no active writer; Files browse/list/download/live read observes the payload root and executable attachment must use the Agent Task sandbox owner path.
afscp_workspace_binding.not_found: Treat as no active writer; Files browse/list/download/live read observes the payload root and executable attachment must use the Agent Task sandbox owner path.

read_export.pending: Return typed pending/failed for unavailable payload root projection; do not trigger runtime-access release or keep a pending read export warm for Files browse/list/download/live read.
read_export.releasing: Runtime release fences apply only to explicit restore/quiesced operations; Files browse/list/download/live read does not wait for read-export release convergence.
read_export.offline: Do not create or reuse a read export for Files browse/list/download/live read; observe the payload root through live storage.
read_export.not_found: Do not create a fresh read export for Files browse/list/download/live read; observe the payload root through live storage or return typed pending/failed when projection is unavailable.

classification_rules.clean_pass: The focused gate passed without runtime pending/readiness markers; evidence keeps empty signals and call summaries.
classification_rules.runtime_flake: The focused gate first observed sandbox unavailable, sandbox rate limited, or runtime pending/readiness markers, then passed on rerun; keep runtime evidence and record the pass as a runtime flake.
classification_rules.stability_blocker: The same focused gate observed consecutive sandbox unavailable or runtime pending/readiness failures; escalate to a stability blocker until runtime owner evidence explains or fixes the repeated failure.
